benchmark_answers.answer: [q1] Answer: The SEO/GEO architecture is UI -> domain adapter/tools -> AI/recommendation service backed by Core. [q2] Answer: The Content Writing architecture is ideation -> outline -> draft -> edit -> publish -> post-publish, with LLM role per stage, human review point, style guide injection, load-bearing controls, stylistic choices, and file:line evidence in Q2.

[q3] Answer: The Ads architecture is campaign feed -> bidding -> reporting -> attribution model -> optimization around conversion event data, budget pacing, anomaly detection, platform-agnostic boundary, data model, and file:line evidence in Q3.

[q12] Answer: Social cognition names platform game theory, algorithm preference, community fit, brand voice, viral mechanics, automation visibility, anti-patterns, worked here and failed here evidence, and platform difference.
